messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — kicking off the FlightPath onboarding for NorthStar Health. Goal: get them to production sandbox + 2 core flows in 30 days, adoption signal in 60.

maria_cs: Quick ask: please confirm owners for setup, enablement, and feedback capture so we can lock calendar invites.

dan_csm: I'll own the commercial checklist (contracts, billing, renewal watchlist). Marking potential renewal risk: their legal timeline is tight — 90d target might slip. :thinking_face:

priya_se: I'll handle the integration wiring and one-touch demo for their infra team. ETA: infra access by day 3, basic embeddings test by day 7.

leo_customer_pm: Thanks — priority flows: (1) patient triage chat, (2) clinician note summarization. Success criteria: NPS >= 70 on pilot, 99th pct latency < 400ms, and false-positive rate for triage intents < 5%.

jenna_onboard: I'll run enablement + runbook sessions. Proposed cadence: 
- Day 0: orientation (30m)
- Day 3: infra handoff (45m)
- Day 7: enablement deep-dive (1h)
- Weekly check-ins thereafter
Can we do Day 0 tomorrow 10am PT?

leo_customer_pm: Tomorrow 10am PT works for me. @NorthStar leads said they'd prefer mornings.

maria_cs: I'll send invites once owners are confirmed. Dan — can you outline the renewal watch triggers you mentioned? We should capture in the success doc.

dan_csm: triggers: low usage after 30d, missed legal milestones, >3 infra incidents in pilot, or lack of executive sponsor check-ins. If any trigger fires we escalate to AM + RevOps.

priya_se: FYI on infra: NorthStar uses private VPC. We need a short checklist for Private deployment:
```
- VPC peering IP ranges
- Customer firewall rules
- KMS key rotation window
- Test model: small-quant v2
```
I'll send the template to the thread.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: reminder set for 1748609950 (Day 3 infra handoff).

jenna_onboard: For feedback capture, propose we use a shared Google Form after each enablement session and a short weekly survey for pilot users (3 Qs). I'll own the form and results summary.

maria_cs: Nice. Can we agree on owner map right now?
- Customer Success: maria_cs
- Commercial / Renewal: dan_csm
- Integration / Infra: priya_se
- Product / Pilot success: leo_customer_pm
- Enablement / Feedback: jenna_onboard
(Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm or @ the person if different)

leo_customer_pm: :thumbsup: confirmed.

priya_se: :thumbsup: confirmed. I'll post the VPC checklist shortly.

dan_csm: :thumbsup: noted. I'll draft renewal watch SOP and put it in the Drive.

jenna_onboard: :thumbsup: added survey + calendar blocks.

maria_cs: Great — I'll send calendar invites + initial success doc (with timelines and KPIs). Action items summary:
- maria_cs: send invites + success doc (today)
- priya_se: VPC checklist + test model (EOD)
- jenna_onboard: survey form + enablement agenda (EOD)
- dan_csm: renewal watch SOP (48h)
- leo_customer_pm: confirm pilot user roster (EOD)

maria_cs: If no objections I'll close this thread after invites are out. Thanks team! :rocket:
